Entry Concept of Rule in the Reach The view of governance in the Reach is shaped by the rich farmland, knightly etiquette, Oldtown knowledge, and Highgarden vassal network. It is not an abstract principle: the superiors use it to explain why they should be obeyed, and the inferiors test it by whether they can get protection, food and justice. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

The distant system is not empty talk only if it can be implemented in campfires, city gates and inns.

Entry Concept of Rule in the Reach The view of governance in the Reach is shaped by the rich farmland, knightly etiquette, Oldtown knowledge, and Highgarden vassal network. It is not an abstract principle: the superiors use it to explain why they should be obeyed, and the inferiors test it by whether they can get protection, food and justice. If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
